mentions.name: MedAngle
mentions.description: Agentic AI super app for medical and dental school that aims to provide everything a student needs from the first day of admission until graduation, with subsystems including MedGPT, MedAgent, and Spaci (a spaced repetition tool).
mentions.audience: Medical and dental students and doctors
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on MedAngle, the world's first Agentic AI Super App for medical and dental school. You can think of it as literally everything one would need from day one of admission till graduation day as a doctor.
mentions.author: maz1b
